objective: To describe the layout and data source of the Download Daily Order Monitoring report (Excel).
The report exports the Order List of the Daily Monitoring screen with the same criteria, data visibility and sort order as the screen, including all pages.

operation.text: Get Parameters

The report is generated on demand when the user clicks [Export] > [Export ke Excel (.xlsx)] on the Daily Order Monitoring screen. It uses the parameters in General Description "Report Generation Keys" exactly as they are on the screen at the time of the click (the user does not need to click [Find] again).

items: Header filters: Date From, Date To, From Loc., To Loc.
DTP tab: ALL / DTP 1 / DTP 2 / DTP 3 / DTP 4.
Search keyword of the Order List.
Current sort column and direction of the Order List.
Login user (role, trucking company, truck) for data visibility.

operation.text: [Print / PDF] in the same menu calls the browser print of the screen and is not part of this report.

operation.caption: Operation Overview - Download Daily Order Monitoring

operation.text: Create Report
2.1 Check session
If the session is expired - cancel export. Log item No.1 in Logging Message Table.
2.2 Connect to database
CONNECTED - go to 2.3. CANNOT CONNECT - Log item No.2 in Logging Message Table; cancel export.
2.3 Retrieve data (same rule as the Order List grid)
Data visibility by login user: IELP Admin / Planner VPLD - all orders; Supplier (Viewer / LP Admin) - orders of own trucking company; Driver - orders of own truck.
Filter: Order Date >= Date From (if filled) and <= Date To (if filled); DTP Loc. From = From Loc. (if selected); DTP Loc. To = To Loc. (if selected); Type = DTP tab (if not ALL).

Search keyword (if filled, case-insensitive, contains) on: No. Order, Trucking Comp., License Plate, Driver, DTP Loc. From/To, Renban, Shift, Type, Date, Order Status, PO Number, Container No. and status of every cycle.
Sort by the current sort column / direction of the grid (default No. Order ascending).
All matching records are exported, not only the current page of the grid.
If no record - show message, no file. Log item No.3 in Logging Message Table.
If record count > maximum rows (TBD) - show message, no file. Log item No.4 in Logging Message Table.
Generate Excel Report File
Create file "Daily Order Monitoring_YYYYMMDDHHMISS.xlsx" (system date-time of the click) with one sheet "Daily Order Monitoring" using the template in Figure 1 / Figure 2 of Report Layout.
Header (rows 1-9): report title, Printed by (user name + role), Printed date, and the criteria used; empty criteria printed as "All" (Search as "-").
Column header (rows 11-12): single columns merged over 2 rows; CYCLE 1..5 merged over 3 columns with sub-header Time, Status, Container No.
Body (row 13 onwards): one row per order, No = running number 1..n in the sort order of 2.3.d.
Cycle n columns: if the order has no cycle n, print "-" in Time, Status and Container No. Time = latest activity time of the cycle (Finish Cycle, else Pick Up, else Start Cycle).
Footer: one empty row, then "Total : n record(s)".
If generation fails - Log item No.5 in Logging Message Table; no file.
Download
Send the file to the browser download; show message with the number of rows. Log item No.6 in Logging Message Table.
The file is not stored on the server (Report File Keeping Period: not applicable).
REMARK >> Export does not change any data. Cell styling (bold header, borders, freeze pane): TBD.
